8423: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lean back slowly while keeping your back straight.
Stop where you can still hold your form, then return to upright using your abs.
8424: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists to guard position.
Punch one arm across your body, rotating the trunk slightly.
Pull it back and punch with the other arm.
8431: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Interlace your fingers and raise your arms overhead.
Turn your palms to the ceiling and reach up tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
8433: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair and extend one leg with the heel on the floor.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward your toes.
8434: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your arms crossed or reaching forward.
Tuck your chin and round your lower back.
Roll your spine forward one segment at a time.
Reach toward your knees and pause.
Roll back up slowly to a tall position.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.
8479: Stand on one foot on the bosu ball and hold your arms in front for balance.
Reach the free leg back behind you.
Sit your hips back and lower into a single-leg squat.
Drive through the standing foot to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
